capabilities: Export notes as Shunn-format DOCX files
Generate first-page contact block and word count header
Add running surname/title/page headers from page 2
Convert scene breaks, headings, italics and em dashes to manuscript conventions
Configure font, underline italics and anonymous submissions
extras: The README documents input conventions that must be followed (blank lines between paragraphs, -- for em dashes) and notes limits such as no bold support and no sentence-spacing normalisation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to produce properly formatted manuscript DOCX files for magazine submissions, forcing writers to reformat by hand.
summary: Exporter that converts notes into William Shunn Proper Manuscript Format DOCX files for short fiction submissions.
